method: Retrospective public issue sample frozen without viewing implementation or ranking. Six exact, useful primary-source checks and two scoped negatives. Open issues checked by API and disjoint from earlier tracked audits and the two preceding independent batches. Two cases require non-Vulkan D3D12 contracts. A hit requires a pinned source and the specified useful line range. Related documentation without the written decision does not qualify. External standards or code may inform independent validation; this suite does not establish prior actual reuse, bug confirmation or performance causation. For gpu-allocator 0.28.0, raw tag bytes matched Git blob hashes returned from the exact commit by the GitHub contents API.

cases.title: GPU (D3D12): Incorrect 3D texture data uploads with UnrestrictedBufferTextureCopyPitchSupported
cases.mechanism: The SDL D3D12 unrestricted-copy feature path corrupts later slices of a 3D upload.
cases.decision: Check texel-unit alignment, footprint offset, row/slice stride, and per-slice readback before restoring the legacy blanket alignment. The D3D12 conformance contract covers 3D slices.

sources.note: D3D12 capability and whole-texel alignment rule.
Independent specified conformance control for exact 3D slice data.

cases.title: SDL_gpu: primitiveRestart in vulkan backend
cases.mechanism: SDL currently disables primitive restart in its Vulkan input assembly. The request asks for an API to control it.
cases.decision: Check indexed draw mode, restart marker for the index width and the additional features needed for list topologies. Do not toggle restart unconditionally.

sources.note: Index-width-dependent restart markers and list topology feature gates.
Exact restrictions for list and patch-list topology.

cases.title: D3D12 / Vulkan: Binding multiple slices of a 3D texture causes validation errors
cases.mechanism: Two render targets select distinct depth slices of one 3D mip. The D3D12 barrier state applies to the same subresource.
cases.decision: Deduplicate D3D12 barriers by resource and actual subresource index, not by depth slice. A useful control uses two distinct slices of one mip and two genuinely different mips.

sources.note: D3D12 uses one subresource index for all slices of a volume mip.

cases.title: Not validating type mismatch between user interface variables.
cases.mechanism: The reporter asks whether a vertex output array matches a fragment input vector with the same components.
cases.decision: For the ordinary vertex-to-fragment path, test type-declaration equivalence, handling stage-specific exceptions separately. Equal component counts alone do not establish a type match.

sources.note: The explicit type matching rule and its exceptions; an incidental VUID about component counts does not answer the issue.

cases.title: Vulkan: MAP_WRITE staging buffers allocated in ReBAR VRAM since gpu-allocator switch
cases.mechanism: The Vulkan wgpu allocator switch changed MAP_WRITE memory placement on ReBAR hardware.
cases.decision: The exact gpu-allocator 0.28 preference prioritizes host-visible, coherent and device-local memory together. Compare it with the fallback without the local bit for a one-copy upload staging control. The code verifies policy, not the measured performance impact.

sources.note: Independently maintained allocator implementation with preference and fallback bits.

cases.title: Missing validation if renderpass output is used as input attachment but not mapped with `vkCmdSetRenderingInputAttachmentIndices`
cases.mechanism: A shader explicitly decorates a depth input attachment index, but the command buffer leaves the default mapping while depth writes are enabled.
cases.decision: Check the default depth/stencil mapping and whether the shader lookup is classified as an attachment read. For overlapping write plus non-attachment access, compare the explicit feedback-loop requirement. This helps identify the missing validation condition without relying on the linked private discussion.

sources.note: Defines the command and default depth/stencil mapping before it is called.
Ordinary overlapping write plus non-attachment use is invalid unless feedback-loop conditions apply.

cases.title: Window resizing lags with white rectangles on Windows
cases.mechanism: The report shows Windows resizing artifacts on Vulkan and D3D12 but does not identify a specific swapchain rule violation.
cases.decision: Use a platform and backend control first. General presentation or render-pass source lines cannot determine the mechanism of the white rectangles.

cases.title: Trollheim Gnomes (UE 5.7.4, AppID 4584570): character sprite visible only from certain angles on NVIDIA Pascal (GTX 1080)
cases.mechanism: The report shows camera-dependent sprite flicker on one DX12 compatibility stack without a useful narrowed shader or API diagnostic.
cases.decision: Separate shader and rasterizer behavior with a minimal capture and platform control. A related feature flag or generic shader-cache warning does not establish applicable prior work.
